## Summary

Feature release introducing the Call Center built-in persona (Haggle's 9th mode), the hands-free Auto Answer engine, native Apple Speech on-device recognition for macOS 26+, the NVIDIA NIM & Riva streaming speech-to-text provider, and native CJK PDF meeting exports.

## What's New

- **Call Center Built-in Mode (9th Persona)** — Dedicated customer support and IT helpdesk mode featuring structured diagnostic workflows, empathetic de-escalation, product runbook grounding, and structured escalation protocols (`Customer Issue & Intent`, `Diagnostic Steps Attempted`, `Root Cause & Resolution`, `Escalation & Follow-up Details`).
- **Hands-Free Auto Answer Engine (Beta)** — Real-time ambient background evaluator that listens continuously to the interviewer, screens for actionable questions, suppresses conversational backchannels (*"yeah"*, *"okay"*, *"sounds good"*), filters short noise (<3 words), enforces confidence thresholds (≥0.6), and triggers answers hands-free (toggle via `CommandOrControl+Shift+A` or the glowing top-pill indicator).
- **Apple Speech On-Device STT (macOS 26+)** — Native, 100% on-device speech-to-text using Apple's modern Speech framework (`SpeechAnalyzer` / `SpeechTranscriber`). Zero cloud latency, zero external API fees, and fully fail-safe on Windows/Linux to maintain cross-platform parity.
- **NVIDIA NIM & Riva Streaming STT Provider** — Native streaming STT supporting NVIDIA Cloud Functions (Parakeet-CTC 1.1B, Parakeet-TDT, Canary-1B) and self-hosted Riva microservice endpoints with VAD boundary detection, RMS silence energy gating, and automatic 16kHz resampling.
- **CJK Meeting PDF Export Engine** — Export meeting summaries, key takeaways, and transcripts directly to formatted PDF documents with native ideographic CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) line-breaking (`word-break: break-word; line-break: strict;`), clean pagination, and print-ready typography.
- **Cloudflare Edge Global Network (`edge.algeris.com`)** — Production endpoints for Vision OCR (`/v1/ocr`), streaming chat (`/v1/chat`), and speech-to-text relay (`/v1/stt/relay`) running on Cloudflare Workers Anycast network with sub-150ms TTFT and automatic Groq failover.
- **Dual-Path Nova-3 STT Ladder** — In-isolate Workers AI Deepgram Nova-3 WebSocket binding (zero external tokens) paired with AI Gateway provider-native route, direct Deepgram fallback, and standby OCI relay.
- **Autonomous Agent Runtime (`haggle-oracle`)** — Secure background mission execution over private Cloudflare VPC tunnel to OCI with 5-tier resilient fallback cascade (Anthropic Claude $\rightarrow$ Google Gemini $\rightarrow$ Hugging Face $\rightarrow$ Groq $\rightarrow$ Safe Simulation) and signed HMAC callbacks.

## Improvements

- **Top-Pill Auto Answer Status Indicator** — Live visual status pill in the overlay header showing idle, listening, evaluating, answering, and cooldown states with smooth animated pulses.
- **Meeting Details Export Suite** — Added direct PDF Export button in the Meeting Details view with instant save dialog and download feedback alongside Markdown, JSON, and Text formats.
- **Prompt Token Deduplication** — Standardized all mode templates on the shared mode prefix constant, preventing redundant token overhead during LLM context assembly.

## Fixes

- **Cross-Platform Speech Safety** — Guarded platform-specific speech engines (`darwin`) so non-supported platforms safely fall back to managed cloud/local STT without runtime exceptions or UI crashes.
- **Backchannel Interference Elimination** — Auto Answer evaluator ignores filler phrases and non-interrogative acknowledgments, preventing false answer triggers during normal conversational flow.

## Technical

- **Swift CLI Native Bridge** — Added lightweight native Swift executable (`native/apple-speech/main.swift`) streaming 16kHz 16-bit mono PCM via stdin and emitting JSON transcription chunks.
- **NVIDIA Streaming Frame Buffer** — Integrated 2.5-second frame buffering with VAD speech-ended event flushing, RMS silence gate (threshold 150), and automatic multi-channel downsampling.
- **Offscreen Electron PDF Printing** — Implemented headless `webContents.printToPDF` pipeline with isolated DOM construction and system file dialog handling.

## macOS Installation (Signed Build)

Download the correct architecture `.dmg` or `.zip` file for your device (Apple Silicon or Intel).

- **For Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4):** Download the `arm64` build.
- **For Intel Macs:** Download the `x64` build.

Open the downloaded file, drag **Haggle** to your **Applications** folder, and launch it.

## ⚠️ Windows Installation (Unsigned Build)

When running the installer on Windows, you might see a "Windows protected your PC" warning from Microsoft Defender SmartScreen saying it prevented an unrecognized app from starting. 

Since this is an unsigned build, this is expected. You can safely ignore it by clicking **More info** and then **Run anyway**.
